# Resonance YouTube Optimizer

> Part of **The Resonance Hub** (https://reson8.life) — the hub is the source of truth for pricing, checkout, updates, support and ecosystem bundles. This spoke delivers AI-powered YouTube channel audits, content strategy, thumbnails, and growth analytics.

For pricing, credits, project packs, account, invoices and ecosystem bundles, follow the hub links below rather than any spoke-local page.

## Hub (source of truth)

- [The Resonance Hub](https://reson8.life): Ecosystem home, governance, and support.

- [Hub checkout](https://reson8.life/checkout): Buy credits or packs for any spoke.
